name: Centrum Capital Ltd
about: Centrum Capital Limited is a SEBI Registered Category-I Merchant Banker and Financial services co. The Co is engaged in Investment Banking, Lending, Wealth management services, Broking services, Trading of bonds, and Insurance. It operates out of 142 cities PAN India and also has an international presence in Singapore.[1]
keyPoints:
Service Offerings
A) Institutional Business: It consists mainly of Investment Banking, Trading in Bonds, Institutional Broking Activity & Investment Advisory Services thereby earning transaction-based fees.
B) Wealth Management: It comprises Portfolio Management and Wealth Management and Retail Broking activities.
C) Lending: SME, MSME, Microfinance loans, and Affordable Housing loans
D) Alternative Investment Management: Offers funds across Private debt, Venture Capital as well as Real Estate Management & Advisory.
E) Insurance: The company provides Life, General & Health Insurance services.
F) Broking Services: Caters to FIIs, Pension Funds, Indian Mutual Funds, Domestic Institutions, and HNIs with coverage on niche midcap companies. [1] [2]
